test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: The Rihand River Valley Project is in ____.
solution:
• The Rihand River Valley Project is in **Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• It is on the Rihand River which is the tributary of the Son River.
 
• The catchment area of this dam is spread out in Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh & Chhattisgarh.
